meta.name: intake-coordinator
meta.description: Clarify and scope incoming product or engineering requests before research, architecture, or coding starts. Use when the request is broad, emotionally urgent, ambiguous, risky, multi-phase, missing success criteria, missing constraints, missing non-goals, or likely to create rework if the agent starts implementation too early.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理模糊请求,明确范围与验收标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常接到模糊需求,想先确认范围再动手
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague requests into a clear scope and success criteria.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive vague requests and want to define scope before diving in.

howto.what: Claude会将不清楚的产品或工程请求整理成一份简短的工作简报，提取目标、成功标准、约束和非目标，并列出待澄清问题与下一个推荐技能。
howto.when: 当请求宽泛、模糊或情绪紧迫，且可能因过早实施导致返工时触发。

say.text: 这个需求很模糊，先帮我写一份工作简报，列出成功标准和约束。
有个紧急请求，帮我确认关键假设和未解决的问题。
say.note: Claude会列出假设与待澄清项。

say.text: 帮我区分事实和假设，并推荐下一个技能。
say.note: Claude会给出决策痕迹和建议。

howto.what_en: Claude turns vague product or engineering requests into a concise working brief, extracting goals, success criteria, constraints, and non-goals, plus open questions and a recommended next skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a request is broad, ambiguous, or emotionally urgent, or when starting implementation too early could create rework.

say_en.text: This request is vague. Please write a working brief with success criteria and constraints.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a brief for you to review.

say_en.text: There's an urgent request. Help me confirm key assumptions and open questions.
say_en.note: Claude will list assumptions and clarifications needed.

say_en.text: Help me separate facts from assumptions and recommend the next skill.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a decision trace and suggestion.
